title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Opinions on Fully Leveraging the Role of Judicial Functions to Provide Judicial Guarantees for Deepening the Reform of the Science and Technology System and Accelerating the Construction of the National Innovation System
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Opinions on Fully Leveraging the Functions of Adjudication to Provide Judicial Guarantees for Deepening the Reform of the Science and Technology System and Accelerating the Construction of the National Innovation System

Fa Fa [2012] No. 15

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Opinions on Fully Leveraging the Functions of Adjudication to Provide Judicial Guarantees for Deepening the Reform of the Science and Technology System and Accelerating the Construction of the National Innovation System of the Supreme People's Court are hereby issued to you. Please implement them earnestly in light of the actual work of adjudication.

July 19, 2012

Opinions on Fully Leveraging the Functions of Adjudication to Provide Judicial Guarantees for Deepening the Reform of the Science and Technology System and Accelerating the Construction of the National Innovation System

To deeply implement the spirit of the National Science and Technology Innovation Conference and the Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Deepening the Reform of the Science and Technology System and Accelerating the Construction of the National Innovation System, and to fully leverage the adjudicative functions of the People's Courts in deepening the reform of the science and technology system and accelerating the construction of the national innovation system, these Opinions are formulated.

I. Further Raise Awareness, Effectively Enhance the Sense of Responsibility and Mission in Providing Judicial Guarantees for Deepening the Reform of the Science and Technology System and Accelerating the Construction of the National Innovation System

(1) Deeply Understand the Importance and Urgency of Deepening the Reform of the Science and Technology System and Accelerating the Construction of the National Innovation System. Science and technology are primary productive forces and an important driving force for economic and social development. The Party and the State have always attached great importance to scientific and technological work. Over the past 30 years of reform and opening up, China's overall scientific and technological strength and competitiveness have significantly improved, playing an important supporting and leading role in promoting economic and social development and safeguarding national security. Currently, China is in a critical period of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and a tough period of deepening reform and opening up and accelerating the transformation of the economic development model. The role of science and technology in economic and social development is becoming increasingly prominent. International scientific and technological competition and cooperation are constantly strengthening. The pace of the new scientific and technological revolution and global industrial transformation is accelerating. China's scientific and technological development faces important strategic opportunities and severe challenges. To seize the opportunity to significantly enhance independent innovation capabilities, stimulate the vitality of social creativity, and truly achieve innovation-driven development, it is urgent to further deepen the reform of the science and technology system and accelerate the construction of the national innovation system. Deepening the reform of the science and technology system and accelerating the construction of the national innovation system are closely related to the intellectual property adjudication and other relevant adjudicative work of the People's Courts. People's Courts at all levels must firmly establish a sense of opportunity, a sense of urgency, and a sense of responsibility, base themselves on their adjudicative functions, identify the entry points and focal points for the People's Courts to serve the overall situation, further enhance the pertinence and effectiveness of their work, exercise judicial power actively, act proactively, and effectively enhance their sense of responsibility and mission in serving the deepening of the reform of the science and technology system and accelerating the construction of the national innovation system.

(2) Fully Leverage the Functions of Various Adjudications to Promote Sound and Rapid Development of Science and Technology. Deepening the reform of the science and technology system and accelerating the construction of the national innovation system require highlighting the role of enterprises as the main body of technological innovation, strengthening the close integration of production, education, research, and application, promoting the open sharing of scientific and technological resources, and the collaboration and cooperation of various innovation subjects. Facing the new situation and new requirements, the People's Courts should be guided by stimulating the source of innovation, enhancing innovation vitality, and developing an innovation culture. They should attach great importance to the trial of cases related to the gestation and creation of scientific and technological achievements, curb illegal acts that infringe upon the rights of scientific and technological achievements, and effectively stimulate independent innovation and technological leaps. They should attach great importance to the trial of cases related to the transfer and transformation of scientific and technological achievements, regulate and guide technological innovation activities, and actively promote the close integration of science and technology with economic and social development. They should attach great importance to comprehensively adopting various strong measures, actively create a judicial environment conducive to scientific and technological innovation, promote the improvement of the level of creation, application, and management of intellectual achievements, and provide strong judicial guarantees for deepening the reform of the science and technology system and accelerating the construction of the national innovation system.

II. Strengthen the Protection of Intellectual Achievements, Effectively Stimulate Independent Innovation and Technological Leaps

(3) Earnestly Implement the Judicial Policy on Intellectual Property of Strengthening Protection, Categorizing, and Applying Appropriate Leniency or Severity, and Reasonably Define the Scope and Intensity of Patent Protection. According to the actual conditions and characteristics of original innovation, integrated innovation, and re-innovation through introduction, digestion, and absorption, further improve the judicial protection system for patent and other scientific and technological achievements and the standards for adjudication. Actively promote major original breakthroughs in key fields and leapfrog development in strategic high-tech fields. Continuously adapt to the increasingly active innovation reality in the scientific and technological field, and constantly strengthen the synchronous updating of the applicable standards of law. In light of the degree of patent innovation and industrial policy, further strengthen the guiding effect of judicial adjudication on scientific and technological innovation activities, and enhance the protection of key fields and core technologies in a targeted manner. For pioneering inventions with a high degree of innovation that have a breakthrough and driving effect on technological innovation, provide a relatively higher intensity of protection and a broader scope of protection, promoting a significant improvement in original innovation capabilities. Moderate strictness shall be applied to the conditions for determining equivalent infringement, avoiding inappropriate expansion of the scope of patent protection, preventing the compression of innovation space and damage to public interests, and promoting a significant enhancement of the capabilities of integrated innovation, introduction, digestion, absorption, and re-innovation. Further improve the rules for interpreting patent claims, reasonably delineate the legal boundaries between civil rights and the public domain, both protecting the legitimate rights and interests of right holders, encouraging inventions and creations, and preventing them from improperly invading the public domain and hindering scientific and technological innovation.

(4) Reasonably Adjust the Judicial Review Standards for Patent Granting and Confirmation, and Actively Encourage Inventions and Creations. Properly adjudicate cases of disputes over patent granting and confirmation, lawfully fulfill the judicial review duty for patent granting and confirmation acts, strengthen the review and judgment of substantive granting conditions, and create a favorable judicial environment for scientific and technological innovation. According to the characteristics of different technical fields, the requirements of specific industrial policies, and the actual situation of China's scientific and technological development, refine and improve the judicial review standards for patent granting and confirmation, promote the standardization and scientificization of patent examination rules and granting acts, and continuously improve the quality of patent granting. Improve judicial review procedures and evidence rules, improve adjudication methods, avoid circular litigation and procedural repetitions as much as possible, promote the substantive resolution of administrative disputes, stabilize the state of rights as soon as possible, and improve the quality and efficiency of judicial review, granting, and confirmation. Fully consider the objective limitations of patent document drafting, within the scope disclosed by the patent application documents, ensure as far as possible that inventions and creations with genuine creativity obtain patent rights, so that the rights obtained by patent applicants match their technical contributions, maximizing the ability of science and technology to support and lead economic and social development.

(5) Strengthen Judicial Protection of Industrial Designs, Promote the Optimization of Economic and Industrial Structure. Lawfully adjudicate disputes involving various types of scientific and technological achievement rights, including invention, utility model, design, and integrated circuit layout design, and actively promote profound changes in China's industrial design and manufacturing levels. Comprehensively utilize various legal means to strengthen the protection of industrial designs, stimulate the creative enthusiasm of designers, promote the continuous emergence of industrial designs that combine utility and aesthetics, and integrate innovation and culture, enhancing China's position in the international division of labor and industrial chain. Implement the legislative intent of the new Patent Law to raise the authorization standards for designs, based on the knowledge level and cognitive ability of the general consumer, appropriately consider the design space of the design, refine and improve the judicial review standards, improve the quality of design authorization, and promote the diversification of product designs. Strengthen the protection of original integrated circuit layout designs, lawfully combat the illegal copying and commercial use of integrated circuit layout designs, and encourage innovation in integrated circuit technology.

(6) Lawfully Clarify the Ownership of Technological Achievements, Stimulate Creative Enthusiasm. Lawfully adjudicate disputes over the ownership of technological achievements and the qualification of inventors, accurately define the legal boundary between job-related achievements and non-job-related achievements. On the one hand, according to the principle of party autonomy, lawfully support inventors in obtaining rights to technological achievements as agreed in contracts; on the other hand, accurately grasp the identification standards for job-related technological achievements to prevent the de-identification of job-related achievements as non-job-related. Lawfully adjudicate disputes over rewards and remuneration for job-related inventors, according to the quality and actual contribution of scientific and technological innovation, protect the right of inventors to receive corresponding rewards and remuneration. This should both stimulate the enthusiasm of enterprise employees for technological innovation and encourage enterprises to increase R&D investment, enhancing the vitality of social creativity.

(7) Properly Handle the Relationship Between Patents and Standards, Reasonably Balance the Interests of All Parties. For patent infringement disputes involving national, industry, or local standards, combined with industry characteristics, the nature of the standard, and the formulation procedure, reasonably determine the legal liability of the parties according to the principle of fair, reasonable, and non-discriminatory (FRAND), promoting the improvement of standard-setting procedures and rules such as prior disclosure of patent information and payment of licensing fees. Reasonably regulate and balance the interest relationship between patent holders and the public, regulate the methods, conditions, and procedures for the public to obtain implementation licenses, encourage the standardization of patents, leverage the role of standards in promoting technological innovation, and prevent standards from hindering technological innovation. Achieve mutual promotion and a virtuous cycle between standards and technological innovation, jointly enhancing the core competitiveness of innovation subjects.

(8) Lawfully Curb Unfair Competition and Monopolistic Acts in the Scientific and Technological Field, Create a Fair and Orderly Innovation Environment. In response to the new situations and characteristics of fierce market competition in the high-tech field and frequent new types of unfair competition practices, properly apply the general clause of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law, based on the principle of good faith and generally accepted commercial ethics, effectively curb various new types of unfair competition practices such as free-riding imitation and obstruction of innovation, providing timely and strong judicial regulation and guidance for the formation of a fair and honest competition order. Strengthen the adjudication of monopoly disputes in the high-tech field, actively explore and summarize new issues in the application of law, effectively curb monopolistic acts, break down industry barriers and departmental divisions, ensure various enterprises have fair access to innovation resources, achieve the reasonable allocation and efficient use of innovation resources, and promote technological innovation and industrial development.

(9) Strengthen Judicial Protection of Trade Secrets, Maintain a Legitimate and Orderly Innovation Order. In light of the actual situation of trade secret protection, given the difficulties in evidence and confidentiality in trade secret disputes, minimize the difficulty for trade secret owners to enforce their rights, reasonably allocate the burden of proof among the parties, and effectively curb acts of infringing trade secrets. Lawfully determine the constituent elements of trade secrets, promote enterprises to enhance their awareness of trade secret protection, standardize and improve confidentiality measures. Properly handle the relationship between the protection of trade secrets and the reasonable flow of scientific and technological talents, both protect the trade secrets of enterprises and ensure the reasonable flow of scientific and technological talents, encouraging the two-way exchange of innovative talents between research institutes, universities, and enterprises.

(10) Strengthen the Protection of Agricultural Scientific and Technological Achievements, Promote Agricultural Science and Technology Innovation. Lawfully adjudicate various types of disputes involving agricultural science and technology, severely crack down on acts infringing upon agricultural scientific and technological achievements, such as producing and selling counterfeit and shoddy varieties and infringing on the rights of new plant varieties, maximize the incentive for agricultural technological innovation, promote the creation of major independent innovation achievements in agricultural biotechnology, advanced manufacturing technology, precision agriculture technology, etc., actively promote breakthroughs in agricultural technology bottlenecks, and seize the commanding heights of modern agricultural technology. From the overall level of China's agricultural science and technology, lawfully confirm the exemption of breeders and farmers from liability, reasonably balance the interests of right holders and the public, accelerate the transfer and transformation of agricultural technology, promote the transformation of modern agricultural management modes, and promote the development of new agricultural industries.

(11) Strengthen Judicial Protection of Trademarks in the Scientific and Technological Field, Promote Enterprises to Enhance Their Innovation Capabilities in Brand Strategy. Lawfully adjudicate trademark disputes, enhance the trademark awareness of technology-based enterprises, support and guide technology-based enterprises to implement trademark brand strategies, encourage them to actively and regularly use their own trademarks in their operations, and improve the market competitiveness and innovation capabilities of enterprises. Severely sanction infringement acts such as trademark counterfeiting and malicious imitation, protect the market value of well-known brands, leverage the brand effect of well-known brands in凝聚创新要素 and integrating innovation resources, and enable enterprises with well-known brands to play a leading role as backbone innovation subjects.

(12) Strengthen Copyright Protection in the Scientific, Technological, and Commercial Fields, Promote Scientific and Technological Innovation, Cultural Innovation, and the Development of Emerging Industries. In response to the new changes in copyright protection needs and the protection field brought about by scientific and technological innovation, based on the needs of cultural innovation and the new characteristics of copyright protection in the commercial field, strengthen the protection of related copyrights, actively promote cultural innovation, business model innovation, and the development of cultural and creative industries, and promote mutual stimulation and deep integration of culture with science, technology, and industry. Vigorously strengthen copyright protection in emerging cultural industries and high-tech fields such as software, databases, animation, the internet, and cultural creativity, accurately grasp the judicial standards for copyright in the new technological environment, and achieve the coordination and unity of incentivizing creation, promoting industrial development, and ensuring that innovation achievements benefit people's livelihoods. Actively respond to the new copyright issues brought about by digitization, networking, and intelligence. While protecting copyright interests, focus on promoting the integration of industrialization and informatization, and enhance the supporting capacity of science and technology for the development of cultural undertakings and cultural industries.

(13) Fully Leverage the Judicial Review Function in the Scientific and Technological Field, Actively Create a Law Enforcement Environment Conducive to Promoting Scientific and Technological Innovation. Lawfully adjudicate administrative cases in the scientific and technological field, support and supervise administrative organs in lawfully sanctioning acts that infringe upon scientific and technological achievement rights, and promote the legalization and standardization of administrative law enforcement. Lawfully accept cases applied by administrative organs for compulsory execution. If they meet the conditions for execution after review, promptly issue a ruling and execute it, and assist administrative organs in creating an administrative management order conducive to intellectual property protection and the construction of the national innovation system.

(14) Fully Leverage the Functions of Criminal Punishment, Severely Punish Crimes of Infringing on Intellectual Property Rights. For criminal acts of intellectual property rights infringement, such as infringing upon trademark rights, copyrights, trade secrets, and counterfeiting patents, further improve the standards for conviction and sentencing, standardize the application of probation, and impose severe punishment according to law based on the circumstances and harmful consequences of the crime. While lawfully imposing principal punishments, increase the application and enforcement of fines, and deprive the offender of the ability and conditions to re-offend by taking measures such as destroying infringing products and pursuing, returning, or compensating for illegal gains.

III. Lawfully Promote the Reasonable Allocation of Innovation Factors, Actively Promote the Close Integration of Science and Technology with Economic and Social Development

(15) Properly Handle Technology Contract Disputes, Promote the Transformation of Scientific and Technological Achievements. Lawfully adjudicate various types of technology contract disputes arising from scientific and technological innovation. Earnestly implement the Contract Law, respect the autonomy of the parties, prudently determine the grounds for contract invalidity and termination, strengthen the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of the observant party, reasonably determine the distribution of benefits and liability arising from the development, transfer, licensing, pledge, technical consulting, and intermediary of technological achievements, guide and support enterprises in strengthening their technological R&D capabilities, promote the close integration of production, education, research, and application, cultivate and regulate the intellectual property service market, and promote the rapid transformation of technological achievements into actual productive forces and market competitiveness.

(16) Properly Handle Labor and Personnel Disputes in the Scientific and Technological Field, Ensure the Reasonable Flow of Scientific and Technological Talents. Adhere to the concept of equally protecting the legitimate rights and interests of workers and the survival and development of employers. Lawfully adjudicate labor and personnel disputes between scientific research talents and employers. Effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of scientific research talents from research institutes, universities, and other units in the process of concluding, performing, modifying, dissolving, or terminating labor or employment contracts. Ensure the reasonable flow of scientific research talents to enterprise R&D institutions, and promote the establishment of open, competitive, and fluid unit employment mechanisms.

(17) Properly Handle Enterprise Restructuring and Bankruptcy Disputes in the Scientific and Technological Field, Optimize the Operating Mechanism of Innovation Subjects. Lawfully adjudicate disputes involving technology-based enterprises, promote the transformation of technology development-oriented research institutions into enterprises, and guide technology-based enterprises to continuously improve their corporate governance structure and establish a modern enterprise system. Lawfully adjudicate disputes involving equity and options invested in technological achievements, reasonably balance the interests of venture capital institutions and innovation subjects such as enterprises, guide venture capital institutions to invest in small and medium-sized technology-based enterprises, and promote the diversification of social investment entities. Lawfully accept enterprise bankruptcy cases and compulsory liquidation cases, properly handle enterprise bankruptcy disputes in the process of eliminating backward technology and excess capacity, and ensure that market entities exit the market lawfully and orderly.

(18) Properly Handle Financial Disputes in the Scientific and Technological Field, Promote Financial Support for Scientific and Technological Innovation. Lawfully adjudicate loan disputes, protect lawful private lending and corporate financing activities, broaden the channels for financial institutions to provide financing for enterprise scientific and technological innovation, and guide banks and other financial institutions to increase financial support for small and medium-sized technology-based enterprises. Lawfully adjudicate disputes over security interests, lawfully recognize guarantees made by enterprises using intellectual property rights and equity pledges, and help solve the financing difficulties of small and medium-sized technology-based enterprises.

(19) Properly Handle Foreign-Related Disputes in the Scientific and Technological Field, Promote International Cooperation and Exchange in Science and Technology. Lawfully and equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties, actively create a fairer, more transparent, stable, and predictable trade and investment environment and development environment, actively promote innovation subjects to fully utilize international and domestic innovation resources, and improve the scientific level and internationalization degree of scientific and technological development. Lawfully adjudicate disputes arising from enterprises' equity participation and mergers and acquisitions, joint development, patent cross-licensing, and foreign investment in establishing R&D institutions in China, promote the introduction of international scientific and technological resources, and promote all-round, multi-level, and high-level international cooperation in science and technology.

IV. Strengthen Overall Coordination, Improve Work Measures, and Further Enhance the Capability of Judicial Guarantees

(20) Strengthen Mediation Efforts, Continuously Improve the Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism. Adhere to the principle of "mediation first, combining mediation with adjudication," with the goal of "case resolution and dispute settlement." Based on the characteristics and realities of scientific and technological innovation, actively guide parties to choose mediation methods such as entrusted mediation, expert mediation, and industry mediation to resolve various disputes in the scientific and technological field. Starting from the perspective of facilitating the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, focusing on the inclusive coexistence of the market interests of the parties, strive to facilitate party reconciliation. For typical cases in which the relevant scientific and technological industry urgently needs clear rules of conduct, render judgments in a timely manner in accordance with the law, clarify legal standards, and fully leverage the guiding and directing functions of judicial adjudication.

(21) Actively Improve the Intellectual Property Adjudication System and Working Mechanism, Continuously Meet the New Demands of Scientific and Technological Innovation for Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property. Adapt to the new situation where the reform of the science and technology system and the construction of the national innovation system require increasingly high levels of specialization in intellectual property adjudication. Further promote pilot work on the centralized adjudication of intellectual property civil, administrative, and criminal cases by intellectual property adjudication divisions. Strengthen guidance and summary of the pilot work, and continuously promote the standardization of the pilot work. Based on the new demands of scientific and technological innovation for judicial protection of intellectual property, coordinate and plan the layout of adjudication jurisdiction over intellectual property. In areas with strong demands for judicial protection of scientific and technological achievements, such as national independent innovation demonstration zones, national high-tech industrial development zones, and national high-tech industry bases, appropriately increase the number of first-instance courts with jurisdiction over technical cases such as patents, new plant varieties, and integrated circuit layout designs. In areas with distinctive innovation resources, appropriately increase the number of grassroots courts with jurisdiction over general intellectual property cases, ensuring that areas with intensive innovation resources take the lead in achieving innovation-driven development.

(22) Strengthening judicial activism to actively promote the improvement of the creation, application, and management of intellectual achievements. While strengthening the judicial protection of intellectual property rights, we shall actively promote the creation, application, and management of intellectual achievements. We shall pay close attention to new situations and new issues arising from the reform of the science and technology system and the construction of the national innovation system, promptly issue judicial interpretations and judicial policies, and enhance the targeted and forward-looking nature of judicial services. We shall promptly summarize mature and feasible judicial experience, submit legislative proposals to the legislative bodies and relevant state authorities, and promote the continuous improvement of the legal system that incentivizes innovation. We shall attach great importance to discovering, through trial work, common and nascent problems that affect or constrain scientific and technological innovation, and promptly submit judicial suggestions to relevant parties such as the government, enterprises, and scientific research institutions to promote the strengthening of management and the improvement of systems. We shall vigorously strengthen the analysis of litigation trends that may have a significant impact on scientific and technological innovation in key technology fields, promptly issue work early warnings to relevant parties, and form a joint force for protecting innovation. We shall strengthen publicity and guidance of public opinion, fully leverage the function of the People's Courts in legal publicity and education, continuously enhance the innovation awareness of the whole society, and further foster an innovation culture that respects labor, knowledge, talent, and creation.
